structured.answer: I'd go with Meitav's "עוקב מדדי מניות" track. It had the highest returns I saw (25.86% over 3 years, 17.25% over 5), the fee of 0.65% is only a bit higher than the others, and I know the name from ads.

stuck.why: Too many options. I almost gave up before I started.
I came for S&P 500, but Harel's 'מניות' track showed higher returns and a lower fee. Didn't know which to pick.
Every row looks the same, so I stopped scrolling halfway through the list.

findings.what: 143 tracks that look alike, with no recommendation and no shortcut. Very tiring.
Every row repeats the same labels (מניות/מט"ח, מהחיסכון/מההפקדות, 3 שנים/5 שנים), so I re-read them on every row just to find what's different.
Lots of rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, so there's nothing to compare them by.
The colours in the ring are only explained with small dots, and the percentages sit beside it, so I had to look back and forth.
Fees are only shown as percents, nothing in shekels, so it's hard to tell if the difference between 0.56% and 0.65% matters.
Nothing tells me what to do next or how to open one.
